verdict.rationale: Fenwick Labs is described as enabling 'automated generation of incorporation documents for new startups' and 'online term-sheet generation for M&A clients,' which gestures at interactive document assembly beyond static templates, but there is no detail on whether founders can self-serve complete these online without attorney involvement, no UI/demo evidence, and the rest of the evidence (trademark extranet, AI research tools) is about internal/client portals, not self-serve founder document assembly. Missing for 10: description of an actual interactive online intake/assembly interface, confirmation it's usable by founders without lawyer mediation, and independent corroboration beyond the single Labs claim.
